provider: Texas A&M Forest Service / Texas Wildfire Risk Assessment Portal (TxWRAP)
interpretation: WildEST deterministic fire-behavior simulations weighted by weather-type probability; long-term relative potential for wildfire difficult to control, not current fire occurrence, wildfire likelihood forecast at a particular dwelling, or FEMA 2025 NRI tract rating.
classification: Official TxWRAP source describes eight WHP classes; keep original published raster legend and source colors rather than inventing a crosswalk to FEMA red NRI grades.
timeRange: source methodology is public but explicit effective revision year could not be confirmed on the REST MapServer landing; dashboard intentionally discloses unverified vintage
limitations: Live raster service availability can change; never leave partial tiles as complete coverage.
No numerical parcel scoring from published raster cache.
Historical wildfire incident dates (2005–2021) are a separate dataset and must not be relabeled as prospective risk.
No local copy of tiled raster or redistribution of contractor GIS data.
qaGates: nonzero PNG tiles loaded at a DFW viewport
distinct source legend and timestamp caveat
FEMA NRI and NFHL mutually exclusive
ZIP color restoration and no school-map regression
